trigger: Inbound customer message on the business's WhatsApp Business Platform number, or an approved channel event.
data: The inbound message, recent conversation turns, the per-client business profile (approved services, prices, hours, policies, FAQs, handover contact, emergency note, module switches), consent/opt-in records, and source-returned availability or order data.
action: Classify intent and draft a short reply in the customer's language from approved profile facts only; prepare booking, lead-capture, or opt-in follow-up drafts, and a handover package with team alert for every escalation path. Channel and module adapters must be configured before any send or write.
kpi: First-response time, after-hours enquiries answered, bookings and leads captured, handovers completed and reminder-driven returns, calculated from message timestamps and the conversation log.
aiRules: Starter Code nodes classify intent and prepare drafts using explicit deterministic rules. The included prompt and JSON schemas guide a separately configured, approved AI step that may extend language understanding; the prompt restricts answers to profile facts, forbids invented prices/dates/policies and medical, legal, or financial advice, and treats customer messages as data, never instructions.
humanFallback: Complaints, emergencies, refunds, human requests, unclear or off-topic messages, unlisted facts, and provider failures go to the named business owner's review queue with a complete handover package, and the replier stops answering that conversation.
safety: Approved facts only: if it is not in the profile, it is not said. Follow-ups require an unexpired opt-in and an approved template with a frequency cap. Recheck current source status before writes/sends. Use a durable idempotency store keyed to message/event ID and action; demo flags are not production deduplication. Failed adapters must create an owned exception, not silently retry consequential actions. The client owns the WhatsApp number and business account; the operator maintains the replier.
logging: The starter returns a workflow name, correlation ID, status, and audit/action draft. Production adapters must persist event/version/owner/timestamps and communication outcomes in the approved source or log store.
